proton-jab.name: Proton Jab
proton-jab.description: A reliable jab. No reaction required.

spark-flare.name: Spark Flare
spark-flare.description: Ignites the target. Pyron's signature line. May inflict Combusting.

acid-splash.name: Acid Splash
acid-splash.description: Corrosive splash. Aqualis's signature line. May inflict Dissolved.

ionize.name: Ionize
ionize.description: Strips electrons away. Ionix's signature line. May reduce ATK.

shell-shatter.name: Shell Shatter
shell-shatter.description: Cracks an electron shell. May inflict Oxidised (DEF drain).

thermal-vent.name: Thermal Vent
thermal-vent.description: Releases stored heat in a burst.

neutralize.name: Neutralize
neutralize.description: A basic counter to acids. Super-effective vs Acid.

precipitate.name: Precipitate
precipitate.description: Crashes the target's stat boosts out of solution.

catalyze.name: Catalyze
catalyze.description: Lowers the activation energy — grants an extra action this turn.

decompose.name: Decompose
decompose.description: Breaks a large foe into two weaker halves.

combustion-cascade.name: Combustion Cascade
combustion-cascade.description: Pyrochemist's Catalyst Burst — a chain of detonations.

universal-solvent.name: Universal Solvent
universal-solvent.description: Solvent Adept's Catalyst Burst — dissolves everything, buffs included.

nuclear-realignment.name: Nuclear Realignment
nuclear-realignment.description: Nucleon's Catalyst Burst — rips the nucleus apart and stuns.

isotope-flux.name: Isotope Flux
isotope-flux.description: The Unstable Isotope's attack — radioactive flux.

ionic-bond.name: Ionic Bond
ionic-bond.description: Forces an electron transfer — locks the target into a brittle lattice. May inflict Oxidised (DEF drain).

covalent-shell.name: Covalent Shell
covalent-shell.description: Weaves a shared electron pair into a tight shell around the target. May reduce ATK.

lattice-collapse.name: Lattice Collapse
lattice-collapse.description: Collapses a metallic lattice inward — crystallises the target's stat boosts back out of solution.

lattice-flux.name: Lattice Flux
lattice-flux.description: The Sundered Lattice's attack — a pulse of collapsing crystal structure.

synthesis-fuse.name: Synthesis Fuse
synthesis-fuse.description: Fuses two reagents into an inert compound around the target. May reduce ATK.

combustion-flare.name: Combustion Flare
combustion-flare.description: A controlled flare of combustion. May set the target alight (Combusting).

flame-surge.name: Flame Surge
flame-surge.description: The Eternal Flame's attack — a roaring surge of fire.
